name: BWild Grain Free Adult Cat Paté

variants.name: Cod 100 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge BWild Grain Free Cod - is a complete food for adult cats. Specially formulated for your cat's well-being, thanks to a careful selection of alternative, non-grain protein sources such as green beans and carrots. Recipe enriched with X.O.S. (xyl-oligosaccharides), the latest generation of prebiotics, to support the digestive system. Contains yucce schidigera to reduce faecal odour.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Codfish (26%), pork liver, chicken meat, fresh carrots (2%), dried tomato pomace, dried green beans 1% (equal to 4.3% of fresh green beans), minerals, hydrolysed animal protein, xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.1%), yucca schidigera (0.1%), spirulina.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 9.5%, Crude fibre: 1%, Crude fat: 5%, Crude ash: 1.6%, Moisture: 79%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 294 IU/kg, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate) 10.5 mg/kg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.05 mg/kg) 0.02 mg/kg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 7.5 mg/kg) 2.4 mg/kg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 35 mg/ kg): 28.1 mg/kg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 3 mg/kg) 0.76 mg/kg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 25 mg/kg) 8.22 mg/kg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 0.4 mg/kg) 0.26 mg/kg, taurine 1,000 mg/kg.
